landing.title: Report infrastructure damage in your area
landing.description: Help UNDP analysts coordinate crisis response by documenting damaged buildings, roads, and utilities — even without an internet connection.
landing.feature_offline: Works offline — reports sync automatically when you reconnect
landing.feature_gps: GPS-located so responders know exactly where to go
landing.feature_anonymous: Reports are anonymous and reviewed by UNDP analysts
landing.label: Community Reporting Tool
landing.privacy_note: Data is anonymised and used solely for coordinating humanitarian response.

photo.title: Take or upload a photo
photo.description: A clear photo helps analysts assess the damage.
photo.error_blur: Image is too blurry — please retake
photo.error_size_small: Image file is too small (minimum 200 KB)
photo.error_size_large: Image file is too large (maximum 15 MB)
photo.error_generic: Could not read image — please try another

crisis_type.title: What type of crisis?
crisis_type.description: Select the crisis that caused this damage.

infra_type.title: What type of infrastructure?
infra_type.description: Select the type of structure or infrastructure affected.

severity.title: How severe is the damage?
severity.description: Select the level of damage to this structure.
severity.minimal_desc: Damage is minor — structure is still usable.
severity.partial_desc: Significant damage — structure is impaired or unsafe.
severity.destroyed_desc: Complete destruction — structure is unusable or collapsed.

location.title: Where is the damage?
location.description: Use GPS for accuracy, or describe the location in text.
location.no_building: No building footprint found — unmapped structure.
location.landmark_placeholder: e.g. Blue house on the corner of Market Road and 3rd Street, near the water tower
location.error_permission_denied: Location access denied. Please use the text description below.
location.error_unavailable: Could not determine location. Please use the text description below.
location.error_timeout: GPS timed out. Please try again or use the text description.
location.error_unsupported: GPS not available. Please describe the location below.

details.title: Additional details
details.description: These details help coordinate the response.
details.needs_placeholder: Describe the most urgent needs for this area…

success.title: Report submitted!
success.description: Your report has been received and will be reviewed by UNDP analysts.

offline.saved: Saved locally — will sync when connected
offline.offline_description: Reports will be saved locally and uploaded when you reconnect.

duplicate.warning_description: A report with {{score}}% similarity was found {{distance}}m away.
duplicate.same_damage: Yes, this is the same damage
duplicate.auto_warning: Very similar report detected. Please confirm this is unique damage.

errors.photo_required: Please add a photo before continuing.
errors.location_required: Please provide a location (GPS or description).
errors.submit_failed: Failed to submit report. Please try again.
errors.network_error: No internet connection. Report saved offline.

export.title: Export Data
export.description: Download filtered report data in your preferred format.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your phone number to receive a one-time code.
login.otp_failed: Failed to send OTP. Please check your number and try again.
login.verify_failed: Invalid or expired OTP. Please try again.

offline.banner: You are offline — reports will be saved locally
